title: Whole Kid Korean Shiso Leaf Dosirak
description: A rich and crisp Korean dish featuring shiso leaf, perfect for kids, made with whole30 friendly ingredients and served in a dosirak format.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
Slice the grass-fed beef into thin strips and season with sea salt and black pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the beef until browned.
Add the grated carrots and sliced zucchini to the skillet and cook until tender.
Blanch the shiso leaves in boiling water for 30 seconds and then immediately submerge in an ice bath.
Assemble the dosirak by placing a scoop of cooked brown rice in the bottom of a container, followed by a few slices of cooked beef and some blanched shiso leaves.
Top with additional grated carrots and sliced zucchini.
